title: Remote bounded-tail repair finds a newer revision without matching metadata and falls back to a full resync
outcome: Bounded-tail repair of a remote session after a restart either succeeds or falls back for a documented, correct reason.
acceptance: For the macbookpro session-6201 occurrence, the code path that found a newer revision without matching metadata is identified, and the cause is classified as a defect or expected behaviour.
A defect gets a fix with a regression test and a clean review pair.
